title: Regression for the Mean: Auto-Evaluation and Inference with Few Labels through Post-hoc Regression
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and testing statistical frameworks (Ridge-PPI and Sigmoid-PPI) for improving the efficiency of model evaluation. While it uses datasets related to LLM refusals (which can include safety and toxic content), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the work.
